item.title: Hiding personal data in Basque texts
item.description:
What is GLiNER2?

GLiNER2 is a family of models for extracting entities (names, places, dates…) from text. What makes it special is that it has no fixed list of labels: we tell it what we want to find (“person name”, “phone number”, “email”…), and it looks for those in the text.

Fastino released a version for detecting personal data (PII, Personally Identifiable Information): gliner2-privacy-filter-PII-multi. It has only 205M parameters and doesn’t need a GPU.
